plugins.name: context-audit
plugins.description: Measure what installed skills cost in context on every request; find truncated, undescribed and overlapping ones.

plugins.name: eval-drift
plugins.description: Per-case regression detection for claude plugin eval: records a baseline and blocks any pass-to-fail flip, independent of the suite average.

plugins.name: injection-probe
plugins.description: Test whether hidden prompt injection in a document survives your pipeline's text extraction and reaches the model.

plugins.name: pr-witness
plugins.description: Asks before a test file is edited or removed; when the agent says the tests pass, runs the base branch's tests against the working tree and shows any claim the run contradicts. Advisory — the signed CI report is the proof.
